Is this a possible leak or an instrumentation issue? Which pipeline section should an integrity engineer inspect first, and which sensors are unreliable?
ENGINEERING ASSESSMENT
Recommended next step
Prioritize integrity-engineer review of Trunk P1 between 200 and 600 metres along the pipe. This accepted inspection bracket surrounds ST2 and ST3, at 300 and 500 metres, where two sensors at each station show sustained pressure deficits. It is a review area, not a confirmed leak point; its midpoint is not a leak coordinate. [claim-026; KN-LOCALIZATION-R1]

What the readings show
P1-ST2-A, P1-ST2-B, P1-ST3-A and P1-ST3-B measured typical pressure 1.055-1.060 bar below their normal references; bar is a pressure unit. All four exceeded the pressure-drop screening threshold throughout the 60-second recording. Nearby ST1 and ST4 were only about 0.035-0.040 bar below their references, making the central deficit roughly 27-30 times larger. These are departures from typical normal pressure, not drops newly observed during this recording. [ev-006; ev-008; ev-010; ev-012; ev-004; ev-014]

Why this matters
A possible leak warrants investigation because the larger negative pattern spans neighbouring stations and two gateways, their shared data connections. Comparing the first and last 30 seconds shows changes of only -0.0087 to +0.0078 bar in the four affected sensors. Small fluctuations are not strongly correlated: onset and propagation were not observed, but that does not erase the sustained deficits. Quiet stations share each affected gateway, weakening a simple whole-gateway error explanation without excluding other measurement biases. Operating changes remain untested because valve and compressor records were not supplied. [PROC-INSPECT-001; subsea_a5693c36101a4b1bac88b90a00470a3d; KN-INDEPENDENCE-R1; KN-OPERATING-R1]

Other instruments to check
No unreliable sensor was identified in the 24 reviewed health records: none had flagged spikes, drift, missing readings, excluded samples or disagreement between sensors at the same station. All 1,440 expected samples were usable, but complete coverage does not independently verify calibration or accuracy. [claim-000 through claim-023; claim-024; KN-QUALITY-R1]

Request independent pressure and flow comparisons around P1 ST2/ST3, using ST1/ST4 and Branch A P2 and Branch B P3 as comparison locations.
